origin.description: Replace every non-ASCII code point with U+001A.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector. A raw vector is coerced with as.character first.

origin.details: A leading BOM is not removed. U+FEFF itself becomes the substitute. NA stays missing.
origin.example:
x <- stri_enc_toascii("\u0105")
cat(paste0("stri_enc_toascii(\"ą\") returns code point ", utf8ToInt(x), ".\n"))

translation.description: Replace every non-ASCII code point with U+001A.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list of those.

translation.details: A leading BOM is not removed. U+FEFF itself becomes the substitute. NA stays missing.
translation.value: A string, NA, or a list of those.
translation.example:
from stringi.encoding import stri_enc_toascii
x = stri_enc_toascii("ą")
print(f"stri_enc_toascii(\"ą\") returns code point {ord(x)}.")
